The L(0..3) counts for these ad hoc witnesses had no pre-computation motivation and no plausible future retrieval need: flatness-constant calibration needs large-width hollow maxima, not width-1 minima; no downstream use, gap, or classification needs these specific dilate numbers. The 4-48 cutoff is arbitrary (all 0-mod-4 T plus 2-mod-4 Q extend indefinitely by the same formulas). Certification (exact fan sums, bbox enumerations) is real but per instructions does not rescue an arbitrary object or unexplained numbers. The missing substantive result (per-volume maxima / obstruction certificates / true maximal hollow witness) cannot be supplied by a bounded interpretive addition; it would require beginning the max-side classification. Hence intrinsic low value: textbook restatement + parameter substitution + unexplained enumeration. FAIL.
